svg.title: Stack
svg.desc: Tech stack. Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS. Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Framer Motion, GSAP. Forms & data: React Hook Form, Zod, TanStack Table, Recharts, Axios. Backend: Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Supabase, Prisma, Drizzle. Payments: eSewa, Khalti, Stripe, PayPal, Razorpay. Ship & tools: Git, GitHub Actions, Vercel, Netlify, Linux, PM2, Figma.
